newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end sharply higher, tone good.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end sharply higher, tone good.

text.p: 1745 GMT - Shares ended sharply higher, lifted by the strength of foreign bourses and traders said that they saw the positive tone being extended.
*There was some sign of funds giving a push to prices for end-year window-dressing, they added.

*The selling of Portugal Telecom by small investors and employees, who were allowed to start from last Thursday off-loading stock bought at the privatisation, seemed to have dried up, traders said. *But Telecel was hit by some profit-taking after its recent sharp rise.
*Traders said that the rate cut by the Bank of Portugal was discounted and had no impact on prices.
*The PSI-20 .PSI20 index rose 0.86 percent to 5,077.59. Futures were up a similar degree.
